label: diffuse token-combination unit (b/p/2/x/m after q/p/b/2/y/a; copy outputs e/v/h/x)
explanation: Active on ~1% of steps, mass split evenly between the original and copy phases; never at t=0 and rare at the delimiter and the first two copy steps. In the original phase it is enriched (max ~4x lift) when the input is b/p/2/x/m, especially following q/p/b/2/y/a; in the copy phase it is enriched when the output token is e/v/h/x. No single token or bigram has a firing rate above ~5%, so the unit appears to depend on a distributed hidden-state combination of tokens. Best single predicate (original-phase bigram) reaches only dev F1 ~0.21; a disjunction with copy-phase outputs gets mass recall ~0.52 but precision ~0.12. Rate rises somewhat for long sequences (L=9) and late positions. Not explained.
